title: Netherlands – Construction work for multi-dwelling buildings and individual houses – Aanbesteding ontwikkeling en realisatie Laborijn-Noord in de Spoorzone Doetinchem
description: Aanbesteding ontwikkeling en realisatie Laborijn-Noord in de Spoorzone Doetinchem. Laborijn-Noord moet uitgroeien tot een levendige en hoogstedelijke stadswijk met maximaal 472 woningen, werkprogramma, voorzieningen en actieve plinten. In dit stedelijke gebied komen de verschillende functies samen, met daarbij een aantrekkelijke openbare ruimte en oog voor sociale veiligheid en hoge ruimtelijke kwaliteit. Dit project vormt een belangrijke stap in de ontwikkeling van de Spoorzone, die een centrale rol speelt in de groeiambities van Doetinchem. Via een aanbestedingsprocedure met selectie en dialoog zoekt de gemeente één ontwikkelpartij of een combinatie van partijen voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van deze opgave. Naast de hierboven genoemde aandachtspunten is Toekomstbestendige gebiedsontwikkeling (TBGO) is een belangrijk onderdeel van de opgave. In de selectiefase wordt van partijen onder andere referentieproject op het gebied van duurzame en/of Toekomstbestendige gebiedsontwikkeling gevraagd. In de gunningsfase wordt het plan voor toekomstbestendig bouwen beoordeeld, met onder andere aandacht voor beeldkwaliteit, hoogstedelijkheid en sociale cohesie. Voor Laborijn-Noord zijn kaders vastgesteld, waaronder het omgevingsplan en het Gebiedsprogramma en het Beeldkwaliteitsplan Spoorzone. Woningcorporatie Sité Woondiensten is een belangrijke stakeholder binnen de ontwikkeling. Zij heeft de intentie om de sociale huurwoningen af te nemen die binnen het project worden gerealiseerd. Hoewel de realisatie van de openbare ruimte geen onderdeel is van de opgave, vragen we partijen wel een voorzet te doen voor de inrichting van de openbare ruimte. Voor de gemeente is het van belang om vastgoed en openbare ruimte als één integraal geheel te ontwerpen. De gemeente Doetinchem kijkt uit naar uw aanmelding.

title: Belgium – Other sources of energy supplies and distribution – Valorisation de capacités de production électrique pilotables au gaz naturel
description: II.1. Objet général de l'avis Le présent avis vise à informer le marché, à titre purement prévisionnel et non contraignant, de la réflexion menée par le pouvoir adjudicateur concernant la mise en place d'un mécanisme de valorisation économique de capacités de production électrique pilotables fonctionnant au gaz et destinées à répondre à des besoins d'intérêt général liés à l'accès à la puissance électrique. Le pouvoir adjudicateur étudie actuellement la possibilité de confier à un opérateur économique, dans le cadre d'un montage susceptible de relever du régime de la concession de services, l'exploitation commerciale et la valorisation économique de capacités de production électrique appartenant ou destinées à appartenir à une autorité publique. II.2. Description indicative du projet Le pouvoir adjudicateur étudie actuellement le développement de plusieurs unités de production électrique pilotables au gaz naturel destinées à soutenir l'alimentation électrique de zones d'activité économique confrontées à des contraintes de capacité du réseau. Le modèle envisagé repose sur une dissociation entre : - la propriété des installations détenue par l'autorité publique porteuse du projet, laquelle pourrait être le SPW ou toute autre entité publique participant à la procédure de marché définitive ; - la valorisation économique de la capacité, confiée à un opérateur économique sélectionné dans le cadre d'une procédure concurrentielle, qui est l’objet de cet appel à manifestation. À titre indicatif, la capacité concernée pourrait représenter jusqu'à quatre sites distincts pour une puissance totale comprise entre 80 et 100 MW. Le principe étudié repose sur la priorité donnée à l'intérêt général. L'installation devra être mobilisée lorsque cela est nécessaire pour répondre aux besoins locaux du réseau électrique. La capacité non requise pour cette mission pourra être valorisée librement par l'opérateur économique titulaire des droits d'usage sur les marchés de l'électricité. Lorsque l'installation est mobilisée à la demande de l'autorité publique afin de répondre à une contrainte locale du réseau ou à un besoin d'intérêt général, un mécanisme contractuel spécifique pourrait prévoir une compensation des coûts ou conséquences économiques directement imputables à cette mobilisation imposée. Les modalités précises de ce mécanisme restent à définir. En dehors de ces situations particulières, l'opérateur supporterait les risques liés à l'exploitation commerciale et à la valorisation économique de la capacité disponible sur les marchés de l'électricité. II.3. RISQUE D’EXPLOITATION Le modèle étudié repose sur l'octroi à l'opérateur d'un droit d'exploitation économique de la capacité disponible. Les recettes tirées de la vente d'électricité, de la valorisation de la capacité ou de tout autre mécanisme de marché applicable constitueraient la source principale de rémunération de l'opérateur. Les modalités de répartition des risques font partie des éléments faisant l'objet du présent appel à manifestation.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Sanierung der zentralen Bettenaufbereitung im Westpfalz-Klinikum Kaiserslautern
description: Die seit 1959 in Haus 7 betriebene Bettenzentrale wurde fortlaufend aus Eigenmitteln instand gehalten. Partielle regelmäßig auftretende Wasserschäden durch das befahrbare Flachdach haben den Gebäudebetrieb beeinträchtigt und mussten temporär behoben werden. Mit der Kernsanierung des Bettenhauses 8 und der damit verbundenen Errichtung einer überdachten Liegendkrankenzufahrt wurde die befahrbare STB-Decke der Bettenzentrale abgeschält und in der gesamten Fläche nun grundlegend saniert. Da die Bettenaufbereitung weiterhin zentral im Haupthaus erfolgt, besteht nun die Möglichkeit, die dort richtig positionierte Bettenzentrale nachhaltig zu sanieren. Neben der bautechnischen Mängelbeseitigung steht die Optimierung der internen Betriebsabläufe im Fokus. Durch die Neugestaltung des Grundrisses sollen logistische Prozesse effizienter gestaltet werden. Insbesondere kreuzungsfreie Wege, speziell die strikte Trennung von reinen und unreinen Arbeitsbereichen, sollen konsequent umgesetzt werden, um die höchsten Hygienestandards dauerhaft zu garantieren. Die Terminplanung des Projektes ist zwingend so auszurichten, dass eine vollständige und prüffähige Aufstellung der HU-Bau im zweiten Quartal 2027 gewährleistet ist.

title: Denmark – Pipeline, piping, pipes, casing, tubing and related items – Supplier Qualification System for SAWL Linepipe and Pipeline Induction Bend Supply Contracts for the Danish Hydrogen Backbone - 26/24083
description: The Danish Hydrogen Backbone (“DHB”) project is a comprehensive effort to establish hydrogen infrastructure in Denmark, connecting planned large-scale renewable hydrogen production in Denmark with the German and European hydrogen markets. The full back-bone is planned to extend from underground storage in northern Denmark to the German border. The first phase focuses on the southern part of the system, with operation planned by the end of 2030. The purpose of the SQS is to establish a pool of qualified Suppliers that may be invited to participate in procurements for SAWL linepipe, external coating and pipeline induction bends required for the Danish Hydrogen Backbone. The first expected call-off is anticipated to concern the Danish Hydrogen Backbone Phase 1. The pres-ently anticipated scope includes 30-inch and 36-inch longitudinal submerged arc welded carbon steel linepipe for high-pressure hydrogen transmission service, with a design pressure up to approximately 98.9 barg. The anticipated linepipe material is API 5L Grade X60 PSL 2 or equivalent. The supply is expected to include manufacture, material traceability, inspection, testing, certification, external 3LPE coating where required, preservation, marking, packing and delivery. The anticipated scope also includes factory-manufactured 30-inch and 36-inch pipeline induction bends compatible with the associated linepipe system. The bends are presently anticipated to comply with ASME B16.49, with radii generally between approximately 5D and 10D and angles between ap-proximately 6 degrees and 90 degrees. The bend supply is expected to include mother or source pipe arrangements, tangent lengths, manufacture, heat treatment where required, inspection, testing, certification, preservation, marking, packing and delivery. Applicants may rely on the technical and professional capacity of another entity, including a specialist induction bend manufacturer, subject to the requirements stated in the SQS documents. The final quantities, dimensions, wall thicknesses, bend radii, bend angles, coating requirements, testing re-quirements, delivery locations and delivery schedule will be specified in the individual tender docu-ments.

title: Utsjokisuun koulun koulukuljetusten hankinta
description: Utsjokisuun koulun koulukuljetusten hankinta Hankinnan kohteena ovat Utsjoen kunnan (jäljempänä myös "hankintayksikkö" tai "tilaaja") Utsjokisuun koulun koulukuljetuspalvelut. Koulukuljetuksissa on kysymys kodin ja koulun välisistä kuljetuksista. Kuljetukset ajetaan lukuvuosittain vahvistettuina koulupäivinä. Koulujen lomakausien aikana koulukuljetuksia ei ajeta. Myös mahdollisten poikkeusolojen etäopetuksen tai muun erityisjärjestelyn aikana koulukuljetuksia ei välttämättä ajeta. Reiteistä ja aikatauluista sovitaan tarkemmin Hankintayksikön ja valittavan palveluntuottajan kesken ennen liikennöinnin aloittamista. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu liitteellä 2 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus sekä muualla tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin, vaan Palvelua hankintaan hankintayksikön tarpeen mukaan. Sopimus ei tuota palveluntuottajalle yksinoikeutta hankinnan kohteena olevien palvelujen suorittamiseen. Hankintasopimus on voimassa määräaikaisena sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta 31.7.2028 asti, jonka jälkeen sitä voidaan jatkaa kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiokaudella. Palveluntuottajalla tulee olla valmius aloittaa palveluiden tuottaminen viimeistään 1.1.2027 alkaen. Tarkemmasta koulukuljetusten aloitusaikataulusta sovitaan erikseen. Optiokausissa on kyse hankintayksikön oikeudesta, mutta ei velvollisuudesta. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on yhden (1) koulun oppilaskuljetuksesta, joka muodostaa yhden (1) yhtenäisen palvelukokonaisuuden. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin ei olisi hankinnan koon, luonteen, kuljetusten toteutustavan eikä palvelun hallittavuuden kannalta tarkoituksenmukaista. Osiin jakaminen lisäisi palvelun koordinointitarvetta ja hallinnollista työtä. Hankintamenettelyn lopputuloksena hankintayksikkö valitsee yhden (1) palveluntuottajan, jonka kanssa se tekee hankintasopimuksen. Osatarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja. Vaihtoehtoiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja.,

title: Germany – Contractor's all-risk insurance services – Projektversicherung für DSD Starterpaket Scan -Med - Augsburg
description: Das gegenständliche Bauprojekt der DBInfraGO AG gehört zum DSD-Starterpaket „Durchfahrbarkeit des Skandinavien–Mittelmeer Korridors“ (ScanMed). Dieser Korridor bildet eines der drei Projekte des Starterpakets, er ist wiederum in mehrere Großprojekte je Netz unterteilt. Im gegenständlichen Projekt der DB InfraGo AG soll die Strecke 5300 mit DSTW-Technik sowie ETCS L2 ausgerüstet werden. Das Projekt ist aufgeteilt auf mehrere Abschnitte, es handelt sich hier um die Abschnitte PA 1 und PA 4 im Netzbezirk Donauwörth und im Netzbezirk Augsburg. Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit ca. EUR 271,8 Mio. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 10,0 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 31.12.2030 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. (Typ M) In der Haftpflichtversicherung beträgt die Deckungssumme je Schadenfall EUR 25.000.000 pauschal für Personen-, Sach- und Vermögensschäden, einschließlich der Leistungen aus der Umwelthaftpflichtversicherung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extended Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelthaftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. Für Personenschäden entfällt der Selbstbehalt. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung ist die erweiterte Planungsdeckung eingeschlossen. Im Rahmen der erweiterten Planungsdeckung beträgt der Selbstbehalt EUR 100.000

title: Madservice - Nordfyns Kommune
description: Nordfyns Kommune ønsker at udbyde madservice inkl. udbringning/levering til hjemmeboende borgere. Udbuddet omfatter ikke levering af mad til borgere, der bor på Kommunens plejecentre. Madservice er en ydelse tildelt efter § 13 i Ældreloven (LBK nr .1651 af 30/12/2024) og/eller Servicelovens §83 (LBK nr 1287 af 28/08/2020). Borgere i eget hjem tildeles ydelsen i henhold til Ældrelovens bestemmelser i § 18 om frit valg samt. Servicelovens § 91. Loven har til formål at sikre, at borgere i eget hjem, der er visiteret til madservice, har frit leverandørvalg. Opgaven omfatter madservice med udbringning, dvs. produktion og levering af mad. Nordfyns Kommune har estimeret det samlede opgaveomfang til at udgøre: • Gennemsnitlig 1.200 portioner pr. uge (hovedretter). Hertil kommer tilkøb af biretter og madpakker. Omfanget er opgjort på baggrund af perioden juni 2025 – maj 2026 (begge inkl). Da borgerne har frit valg mellem leverandører, er omfanget af ydelser efter Aftalen, dels afhængigt af, hvor mange borgere der er berettiget til en visitation til madservice, og dels af borgernes konkrete valg af leverandør. Nordfyns Kommune således ikke sikre leverandøren et minimums køb i aftaleperioden.

description: De gemeente beschikt over een omvangrijke vastgoedportefeuille, waaronder gebouwen en percelen grond (hierna te noemen onroerend goed), die wordt ingezet ter realisatie van maatschappelijke doelstellingen op onder andere het gebied van cultuur, welzijn, sport en onderwijs: maatschappelijke doelstellingen. De Vastgoedorganisatie Utrecht (hierna: VGU) vervult namens de gemeente de eigenaarsrol ten aanzien van dit onroerend goed. Als gevolg van onder meer mutaties, herontwikkeling, verkoop of gewijzigde beleidsinzet kan gemeentelijk onroerend goed tijdelijk leeg komen te staan. Daarom vindt de gemeente het belangrijk dat het onroerend goed veilig wordt beheerd, waarbij ook rekening wordt gehouden met het minimaliseren van de beheerskosten. Ook vindt de gemeente het belangrijk dat het onroerend goed maatschappelijk wordt benut, tenzij dat niet mogelijk is. €400.000,- over 4 jaar.

En cas d'opportunités complémentaires, le donneur d'ordre se réserve la possibilité d'augmenter le volume de logements jusqu'à 20 % supplémentaire et se réserve la possibilité de substituer des lots d’une typologie à l’autre.

title: User Testing Software Platform for User Experience Testing
description: Notice of Proposed Procurement (NPP) for User Testing Software Platform for User Experience Testing This bid solicitation 1000505276/B cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000505276/A dated November 03, 2025 with a closing of December 03, 2025 at 02:00 PM EDT. The solicitation is being reissued as the previous solicitations resulted in non compliant bids. Unless otherwise stated herein, all terms and conditions of the original solicitation remain unchanged. The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) intends to enter into a contract with a single contractor for access to a user testing software platform to test CRA content on Canada.ca with the Canadian public, as well as certain niche audiences such as business owners, families with children, and other demographics as required. The ability to test with persons who use assistive reading and navigation technologies is not within scope for this requirement and has been solicited under a separate procurement by the CRA. The objective is to assess the ease with which users can find information and successfully complete tasks on Canada.ca and to identify any difficulties that users face in navigating CRA content so that solutions can be proposed and implemented to improve those performance measures. This requirement also includes irrevocable options to procure additional quantities of test requests to be used within the User Testing Software Platform annual entity license for the User Testing Software Platform for User Experience Testing. The period of any resulting contract will be for two (2) years with CRA retaining the irrevocable option to extend the period of the contract for up to five (5) additional one (1) year periods. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. The responsive bid with the lowest bid evaluation price will be recommended for contract award. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Conditional Set-Aside Under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business • This procurement may be conditionally set aside under the federal government Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business. • In order to be considered for the set-aside, the Bidder must certify that it qualifies as an Indigenous business as defined under PSIB and that it will comply with all requirements of PSIB. If bids from two (2) or more Indigenous businesses are compliant with the terms of the Request for Proposal, the contracting authority will limit the competition to those Indigenous businesses and will not consider bids from any non-Indigenous businesses that may have been submitted. • For more information on Indigenous business requirements of the Set-aside Program for Indigenous Business, refer to Eligibility for Indigenous procurement set aside and Procurement information for Indigenous business owners Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: Christian.Nkezurukundo@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Appendix 3: Standard Instructions - Goods or Services - Competitive Requirements of the Request for Proposal. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement.

title: CMMA Composite Repair Shelter
description: The Department of National Defence (DND), through the Canadian Multi-Mission Aircraft (CMMA) Project, requires the design, manufacture, and delivery of a clean room facility to serve as an interim Composite Repair Shelter at 14 Air Maintenance Squadron (14 AMS), 14 Wing Greenwood, Nova Scotia. The shelter will be installed within Hangar 10, which has existing temperature-control capabilities, and will remain in service until the construction of the new CMMA hangar. The Composite Repair Shelter will support aircraft composite repair activities, including the application and curing of adhesives, bonds, lacquers, and resins used on composite materials such as carbon fibre, fiberglass, and aramid fibre. Limited quantities of solvents, including acetone, methyl isobutyl ketone (MIBK), and methyl propyl ketone (MPK), will be used during repair operations.

title: Forbruksartikler til renhold og kantinedrift
description: Bakgrunn og formål Vestfold fylkeskommune har i dag en rammeavtale for kjøp av renholds-, papir-, plast- og storkjøkkenprodukter. Avtalen har sluttdato i januar 2027, og det er derfor behov for å gjennomføre en ny anskaffelse for å etablere en ny rammeavtale fra samme tidspunkt. Anskaffelsen skal dekke fylkeskommunens løpende behov for varer og tilhørende tjenester til renhold og kantinedrift ved videregående skoler, tannklinikker, museer og fylkeshuset. Formålet er å sikre stabil forsyning, effektiv drift og lik kvalitet over tid på tvers av lokasjoner. Det er samtidig et mål at den nye rammeavtalen legger til rette for et hensiktsmessig standardsortiment med nødvendige lokale tilpasninger, god sortimentsstyring og en brukervennlig bestillingsløsning. Fylkeskommunen ønsker også produkter og emballasjeløsninger med bedre miljøegenskaper, samt sikker kompatibilitet mellom forbruksartikler, dispensere og maskiner. Produktgrupper det er behov for er: Avfallshåndtering Hygieneprodukter Kantineprodukter Renoldsmidler Renholdsprodukter Tørkepapir

title: France – Signage – CONCEPTION, FABRICATION, FOURNITURE ET POSE DE LA SIGNALÉTIQUE - HÔPITAL 2030

description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS FOR INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. title: Z2DA--666-27-102 Lightning Protection Update B71N
description: GENERAL: Introduction: An inspection for current code compliance of the lightning Protection System on Building 71N has been conducted and found the system needs upgrades and repairs to meet current NFPA 780 and UL96A standards. The Sheridan VA Medical Center needs the services of a qualified contractor to perform the needed lightning protection upgrades to the main hospital building 71N. Located on the Sheridan Wyoming Veterans Affairs Medical Center (VAMC) campus, at 1898 Fort Road, Sheridan, Wyoming 82801. Statement of Work: Specifics a. Existing Conditions The existing lightning protection system (LPS) for Building 71N was installed in 1989 during the building s original construction. Overall, the system remains in fair condition, though it requires repair because several air terminals have become detached from their adhesive bonds to the roof surface. Air terminals are present at all high points of the structure, and all roof-mounted equipment and appurtenances are properly grounded. A main grounding bus connects the communication systems and possibly the electrical distribution system to the primary service ground. The specific location where the grounding system bonds together the structural steel, electrical system, lightning protection components, and plumbing to create an equipotential ground could not be identified during the assessment. A continuous grounding loop encircles Buildings 9, 71, and 71N, with all roof air terminals and down conductors tied into this loop. Down conductors descend to the loop at the corners of each of these buildings. Each air terminal has at least two separate grounding paths, satisfying current code requirements. No Transient Voltage Surge Suppression (TVSS) devices were observed in the system. The lower 8 feet of the ground down conductors are encased in PVC electrical conduit for protection. New Construction Recent construction has added large equipment and a screen wall to the roof, which now obstructs and interferes with the original positioning of the existing air terminals. This new equipment sits higher than the existing lightning protection system components, rendering the current air terminals ineffective at intercepting and safely directing lightning strikes to ground. Project Requirements To bring the existing lightning protection system (LPS) into compliance the following corrections are needed: Install Transient Voltage Surge Suppression (TVSS) devices at the building s main service panel. Establish proper bonding by interconnecting all electrical systems, communication systems, piping, and structural steel at the service entrance to create an equipotential ground. Repair all roof air terminals that have detached or pulled away from their adhesive mounts on the roof surface. Install new air terminals at both ends of each screen wall, with additional terminals spaced at 20-foot intervals along the top of each wall, and at the highest point of the HVAC ductwork. Install an air terminal at each corner of the new HVAC equipment. Connect all newly installed air terminals to the existing LPS using #2 bare copper conductors. After these corrections have been completed, a qualified inspection is required to verify full compliance with NFPA 780 and UL 96A standards. Upon successful inspection, a Master Label Certificate should be issued for the lightning protection system. General: Construction project is to be completed within 120 calendar days from date of Notice to Proceed (NTP). Contractor shall provide all equipment, materials, supplies, tools, software, supervision, and labor required for this project, which may include, but is not limited to, demolition work, providing negative pressure environment for work, and providing all new equipment, utilities, and room finishes as indicated in the plans and this SOW per VA construction standards. Safety submittals shall be completed and approved prior to the commencement of on-site construction work. Material selection submittals shall be completed and approved prior to ordering of materials for the project. The building tenants not in the construction areas will remain at work in the buildings during this construction. Patients will remain on the floor in areas not under construction, so the contractor shall make patient safety, and infection control measures a priority. The contractor shall coordinate work locations and schedules with VA COR to minimize impact to building tenants. All electrical, carpentry, architectural, mechanical work, product design, project management, and other work needed on this project shall be provided by the Contractor. All required electrical work, low, medium, or high voltage, shall be installed and terminated by the Contractor. No wiring or cabling shall be abandoned in place. All piping, cabling, and wiring shall be labeled. All cabling and patch cabling shall match the VAMC s station-standard colors. The installation must, at a minimum, be in accordance with all applicable codes indicated in the Department of Veterans Affairs Design Manuals and VA .PUBLICATIONS (Master Construction Specifications, Construction Standards, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), Underwriters Laboratory (UL), International Building Code IBC 2003, and National Electric Code (NEC) building codes and standards and the VA Information Security Handbook 6500.6, 6550.0 etc.). The Contractor shall read and be familiar with the most current editions of the applicable codes, standards, guides, and manuals. Sources can be accessed at the Office of Construction and Facilities Management s Technical Information Library (TIL) (http://www.cfm.va.gov/TIL). Any penetrations through any floors, ceilings, or walls shall be fire caulked, or otherwise fire sealed, and shall be done in this contract to meet VA standards and NFPA standards. Contractor shall utilize the VAMC s station-standard fire stop products or approved equal product(s). The station-standard products are SpecSeal fire caulk product is SpecSeal SSS Intumescent Firestop Sealant; and, if needed, the SpecSeal Composite Sheet may be used in areas approved by the COR. The Contractor shall inquire of the COR if any existing equipment, fixtures, hardware, doors, frames, or any other property removed is desired to be retained by the VA for reuse elsewhere within the medical center, at the time of removal. If the VA desires to retain an item, the Contractor shall deliver it to a location designated by the COR. If the VA does not desire to retain an item, the Contractor shall dispose of it properly off-station. The new components installed shall be tested and commissioned, re-certified, and/or tested before VA acceptance. All testing parameters shall be provided by the Contractor with source references to the COR and 3rd-party reviewer before testing begins. Copies of all test reports must be provided to the COR. HVAC systems that have changes made to them as part of this project, beyond diffuser replacement, shall be tested and balanced by the Contractor. Any IT data cables installed or modified as part of this effort shall be tested after installation. Test methods and plans shall be coordinated with the COR. Any Med Gas systems modified as part of this effort shall be re-certified back to the closest shut-off in the system. The Contractor shall arrange for any required re-certification as part of this contract and shall provide plans and results to the COR for approval. Fire alarm devices that are tied into the building fire alarm system, that are replaced or relocated as a result of this work, shall be tested before that phase of the project is complete. The Contractor shall arrange for all required fire alarm testing. If a building s fire alarm system is under warranty, testing must be accomplished by the contractor who holds the warranty. title: Z2DA--523A4-CSI-288 3.0T MRI Site Prep - Design Build West Roxbury VA Medical Center (VAMC_ West Roxbury, MA
description: Page 1 of 1 INTRODUCTION: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting proposals and subsequently awarding a single Firm-Fixed-Price contract for the design-build (DB) project #523A4-CSI-288 West Roxbury VA Medical Center located in West Roxbury, MA. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-build approach. The anticipated solicitation will be issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) in accordance with FAR Parts 36 and 15, considering Technical and Price Factors. This project requires comprehensive design-build services for the the 3T MRI Site Preparation Design Build project at the West Roxbury VA Medical Center (VAMC) located in West Roxbury, MA. This project will provide construction of a temporary mobile Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) suite as well as all utility services and finishes necessary in the designated locations to allow for the installation of an MRI system by the Equipment Contractor. The work shall include, but not limited to, all labor, transportation, materials, apparatus, tools, equipment and permits necessary to provide for the renovation of the rooms, removal of the existing equipment, flooring, ceiling, sinks, casework, doors, shielding and installation of new flooring, ceiling, casework, doors, sinks, lighting, painting, med gas, shielding divider and relocation of electrical and HVAC work. Work to be performed at VAMC West Roxbury in accordance with the Statement of Work, Specifications, Drawings, Federal, State, and Local Codes. Strict noise and infection control measures shall be always followed. Off-hours and weekend work may be required to complete contractual requirements due to the location and sensitivity of the patient population. Existing life safety systems within Building 1 shall not be impaired at any time during the performance of the work. ADMINISTRATIVE: The anticipated solicitation will be issued as an RFP in accordance with FAR Part 36.3 Two Phase Design Build Selection Procedures and FAR Part 15 Contracting by Negotiation. The solicitation will be advertised as an SDVOSB set-aside. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45 million. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued in early November 2026. The period of performance is approximately 430 calendar days from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $2,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to the CS and CO: Dawn.Schydzik@va.gov and William.Henkel@VA.gov . Telephone calls will not be accepted. -END-

title: Solicitation: Construct Combat Rescue Helicopter Flight Simulator Facility at Moffett ANGB
description: The Contractor shall provide non-personal services, to include all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary for the construction of a Combat Rescue Helicopter (CRH) Operational Flight Trainer (OFT) simulator facility at Moffett Air National Guard Base (ANGB), Mountain View, California. This project will provide an approximately 8,202 gross square foot building consisting of a multi-story, high bay area to house the CRH-OFT simulator, with a single-story area containing CRH mission planning, briefing and debriefing rooms, administrative areas for training and support staff, OFT maintenance and parts storage rooms, secure and non-secure telecommunication rooms, latrine facilities and mechanical, electrical and utility support rooms utilizing conventional design and construction. The building will be of permanent construction with electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, wet sprinkler fire suppression, fire detection, access control, direct digital control, and utility management. The exterior walls will be constructed with cavity wall construction including interior non-load bearing metal studs (or CMU wall backup at Simulator Bay) with gypsum board and exterior CMU veneer and metal panel. Air space and insulation to be located inside the cavity wall to meet Energy Code requirements. The primary roofing materials will be standing seam metal roofing to match other installation facilities and the perimeter sloped roof design will include a prefinished standing seam metal roof panel system over rigid insulation. The exterior walls will be constructed with cavity wall construction including interior non-load bearing metal studs (or CMU wall backup at Simulator Bay) with gypsum board and exterior CMU veneer and metal panel. Main entrance doors will be a pair of anodized aluminum storefront entrance doors with insulating glass including a sidelight. The Mechanical, Electrical, Sim Bay and secondary egress doors will be painted, insulated hollow metal door and frames with controlled access. Antiterrorism/Force Protection elements are incorporated. Supporting facilities include landscaping, utilities, pavements, storm drainage, sanitary sewer, site improvements, communications support, cybersecurity control systems, and tempest security.

title: DLA-RFI-CT-2027-WBOS-MKTRES
description: DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY (DLA) TROOP SUPPORT CLOTHING AND TEXTILES DIRECTORATE � PHILADELPHIA, PA REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) & SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Whole-of-Government Web-Based Ordering System (WBOS) & Commercial eMarketplace Platform FEDERAL MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE (FAR 15.201(e) & FAR Part 10): This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research, planning, and information-gathering purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO), or an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products or services. The Government is seeking broad industry input on commercial capabilities, architectural options, and market readiness. Responses are strictly voluntary; the Government will not reimburse any costs associated with preparing or submitting responses to this notice. 1. Executive Summary & Purpose of Inquiry The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Troop Support Clothing and Textiles (C&T) Directorate is conducting market research to explore commercial software solutions, digital eMarketplace architectures, and industry best practices for deploying a next-generation Web-Based Ordering System (WBOS). DLA�s Troop Support C&T organization serves as the Federal Government�s primary enterprise manager for military clothing and textiles, working extensively with domestic industry. DLA is currently assessing the expansion of this shared-services procurement model to serve civilian Whole-of-Government (WOG) partner agencies, including the Department of the Interior (DOI), Department of Justice (DOJ), Department of Transportation (DOT), Department of State (DOS), and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The primary objective of this RFI is to engage commercial e-commerce developers, SaaS providers, systems integrators, and domestic textile industry stakeholders. DLA seeks to understand what commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) capabilities exist today, how commercial technology can resolve complex federal supply chain and fiscal integration challenges, and what industry recommendations DLA should incorporate into its upcoming acquisition strategy. DLA is committed to adopting commercial best practices and avoiding custom development wherever commercial platforms can satisfy or be adapted to meet mission requirements. 2. Administrative Overview & Acquisition Milestones Market Research Parameter: Information & Acquisition Guidance Document Identifier: DLA-RFI-CT-2027-WBOS-MKTRES Anticipated Acquisition Approach: Commercial Solutions Opening (10 U.S.C. � 3458) / Commercial Acquisition (FAR Part 12 / Agile Authorities) Primary NAICS Code: 541512 - Computer Systems Design Services (Small Business Size Standard: $34.0M) Secondary NAICS Codes: 518210 - Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services ($40.0M), 541519 - Other Computer Related Services ($34.0M) Product Service Code (PSC): DA01 - IT and Telecom - Business Application/Application Development Software RFI Issuance Date: Friday, October 30, 2026 Industry Questions & Clarifications Due: Friday, November 06, 2026, at 16:00 EST Government Formal Q&A Responses Posted: Friday, November 20, 2026 RFI Capability Response Deadline: Friday, November 27, 2026, at 16:00 EST Anticipated Pre-Solicitation Industry Day: December 2, 2026 (Virtual) Primary Contract Specialist: Courtney Hunter, Contract Specialist, DLA Troop Support C&T (Courtney.Hunter@dla.mil) Primary Contracting Officer: Ryan Zarkowski, Individual Protection and Commercial Solutions Division Chief, DLA Troop Support (Ryan.Zarkowski@dla.mil) Submission Channel: Electronic submission via email to Government POCs (Subject: 'WBOS RFI Response - [Company Name]') 3. Mission Needs & Strategic Challenges The contemplated capability would enable Government-approved vendors to list and maintain Government-approved catalogs; enable authorized agency personnel to purchase authorized items; apply agency-specific eligibility, entitlement/allowance, item-authorization, approval, and management-control rules; support authorized payment methods; and provide auditable transaction, fulfillment, and program-management information. To modernize uniform procurement across DoD and civilian partner agencies, any future solution must address several interrelated operational and regulatory challenges. Rather than dictating prescriptive technical designs, DLA outlines the desired functional outcomes below to invite innovative, industry-driven solutions: Operational Domain: The Operational Challenge / Desired Outcome Commercial Marketplace & User Experience: Deliver a modern, consumer-grade multi-tenant e-commerce experience with sub-second catalog search, faceted filtering, mobile responsiveness, and intuitive uniform selection, while supporting distinct tenant agency branding (DoD, DOI, DOJ, DOT, DOS, DHS) and role-based permissions. Domestic Provenance & Supply Chain Integrity: Because DLA operates as a central procurement hub utilizing the Defense Working Capital Fund (DWCF), end-items transacted through DLA are subject to 100% domestic sourcing requirements under the Berry Amendment (10 U.S.C. � 4862). DLA requires automated mechanisms to verify domestic origin down to the raw material/mill level, screen supply chains for forced labor or prohibited foreign entities, and prevent unverified items from being purchased. Statutory Competition & Micro-Purchases: In a multi-vendor marketplace environment, transactions must respect federal competition mandates (such as CICA and simplified acquisition thresholds). The Government seeks automated, user-friendly marketplace workflows that promote fair competition, facilitate dynamic quoting between micro-purchase thresholds ($15k) and simplified acquisition threshold ($350k), and prevent improper order splitting without creating administrative bottlenecks. Uniform Customization & Value-Added Logistics: Civilian law enforcement and military personnel require customized uniforms (e.g., branch tapes, badges, department patches, embroidery, reflective safety trims, and tailored sizing). The system must support interactive customization, dimensionally accurate digital proofing, supervisor approvals, and tracking of value-added tailoring services while ensuring all component materials remain compliant. Interagency Accounting & Fiscal Guardrails: The system must handle interagency funding across diverse partner departments without risking Antideficiency Act (ADA) violations. This includes integrating with federal financial frameworks (such as Treasury G-Invoicing Form 7600A/B), managing annual individual officer uniform allowances (5 U.S.C. � 5901), supporting multi-payment split tender (allowance + GPC + personal card overages), and reconciling DLA cost-recovery surcharges without contractor fee retention. Cybersecurity & Enterprise Interoperability: The platform will process sensitive federal uniform requisitions, military supply chain data, and law enforcement personnel information. It must meet high federal cybersecurity baselines (such as FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements), support CAC/PIV single sign-on, and interface with federal backbones such as DLA Enterprise Business System (EBS/SAP), PIEE/WAWF, and SAM.gov. Training & Performance Tracking: Provide general user training, program manager training, etc. Implement all necessary work and time management control processes to ensure timely accurate accomplishment of work requirements as well as to permit tracking work in progress. 4. Areas of Inquiry & Market Research Questionnaire Industry respondents are invited to address the following questions. Offerors may respond to all or selected inquiry areas based on their core competencies and commercial experience. 4.1 Pillar 1: Market Position & Differentiation Question 1.1 (Core Competencies): Outline your primary services and expertise, such as previous projects in a similar scope, or any COTS options you currently off

Διαγωνισμός: ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΤΟΥ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΟΔΡΟΜΟΥ ΔΕΝΕΙΑΣ - ΑΚΑΚΙΟΥ - ΑΣΤΡΟΜΕΡΙΤΗ - ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Προβολή Μενού Διαγωνισμού Προθεσμία Παραλαβής των Προσφορών σε (days/hours): 101/22 Όνομα Αναθέτουσας Αρχής: Τμήμα Δημοσίων Έργων Τίτλος: ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΤΟΥ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΟΔΡΟΜΟΥ ΔΕΝΕΙΑΣ - ΑΚΑΚΙΟΥ - ΑΣΤΡΟΜΕΡΙΤΗ - ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Μοναδικός Αριθμός Διαγωνισμού: ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Μηχανισμός Αξιολόγησης: Βάσει Τιμής/Κόστους Περιγραφή: Το έργο αφορά την πλήρη μελέτη και κατασκευή του Αυτοκινητόδρομου Δένειας – Ακακίου - Αστρομερίτη, 4 λωρίδων κυκλοφορίας, συνολικού μήκους περίπου 18 km. Θα συνδέει τον αυτοκινητόδρομο Λευκωσίας-Κοκκινοτριμιθιάς με τον αυτοκινητόδρομο Αστρομερίτη-Ευρύχου και θα διέρχεται νότια των χωριών Ακακίου, Περιστερώνας και Αστρομερίτη. Οι κατασκευαστικές εργασίες, μεταξύ άλλων περιλαμβάνουν 4 ανισόπεδους κόμβους, τη συμπλήρωση ενός υφιστάμενου ανισόπεδου κόμβου, χωματουργικές και ασφαλτικές εργασίες, εργασίες αποχέτευσης ομβρίων περιλαμβανομένων εργασιών κατασκευής κλειστού συστήματος απορροής ομβρίων οδοστρώματος, τροποποιήσεις υφιστάμενων Υπηρεσιών, εγκαταστάσεις νέων Υπηρεσιών, εγκατάσταση οδικού φωτισμού, κοιλαδογέφυρες, υπέργειες και υπόγειες διαβάσεις, ορθογωνικούς οχετούς και τοίχους αντιστήριξης. title: Bulgaria – Telescopic sights – „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“.
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка е „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО. Обществената поръчка не съдържа класифицирана информация по смисъла на § 2, т. 20 от Допълнителните разпоредби на ЗОП. Рамковите споразумения за всяка обособена позиция ще бъдат сключени с едно лице – участникът, класиран на първо място и определен за изпълнител по съответната обособена позиция. В Рамковите споразумения са определени всички условия и на основание чл. 82, ал. 1 от ЗОП, Възложителят ще сключва конкретни договори, като прилага тези условия. - По Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 2960 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 1228 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено е до 1439 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение.

title: Greece – Hire of trucks with driver – ΜΙΣΘΩΣΗ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΣΜΟΥ ΣΕ ΠΟΤΑΜΟΥΣ ΚΑΙ ΡΕΜΑΤΑ ΑΡΜΟΔΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ Π.Ε. ΡΟΔΟΠΗΣ ΕΤΩΝ 2027-2028
description: Η παρούσα μελέτη αφορά την μίσθωση μηχανημάτων και φορτηγών, με την μορφή έξι (6) ομάδων, ως εξής: 1η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>120 ΗΡ) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 2η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>120 ΗΡ) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 3η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>50 ΗΡ έως 120 HP) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 4η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα, 5η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα, 6η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα. Συγκεκριμένα τα μισθωμένα μηχανήματα με τη μορφή ομάδων – συνεργείων, θα χρησιμοποιηθούν για τον καθαρισμό κοίτης και συγκεκριμένα την απομάκρυνση απορριμμάτων και μπαζών, για απομάκρυνση βλάστησης (καλαμιών, θάμνων, δέντρων), για άρση λοιπών εμποδίων (ξεροί κορμοί, κ.λπ.), για διαμόρφωση πρανών για την αποφυγή καταπτώσεων, για φόρτωση και μεταφορά προϊόντων καθαρισμού σε κατάλληλους χώρους καθώς και για τοπικές αποκαταστάσεις ζημιών σε αναχώματα. Οι ως άνω περιγραφόμενες εργασίες θα πραγματοποιηθούν με απώτερο σκοπό την ελεύθερη απορροή των υδάτων σε ρέματα, υδατορέματα, χειμάρρους και ποταμούς στα γεωγραφικά όρια της Περιφερειακής Ενότητας Ροδόπης, τα οποία θα υποδειχτούν από την Υπηρεσία μας και είναι συγκεκριμένα τα παρακάτω δεκαέξι (16) σημεία επέμβασης: Ρέμα Δυτικά Οικισμού Αμαξάδων, Ρέμα Ανατολικά Οικισμού Αμαξάδων ή Αμυγδαλόρεμα, Ρέμα Ασκητών, Ρέμα Βοσβόζη ή Ασπρόρεμα, Ρέμα Γλυφάδας 1, Ρέμα Γλυφάδας 2, Ρέμα Καλλυντηρίου, Ρέμα Μαυρομματίου 1, Ρέμα Μαυρομματίου 2, Ρέμα Παγουρίων, Ρέμα Πανεπιστημιούπολης, Ρέμα Παραδημής ή Χηνόρεμα, Ρέμα Πελαγίας, Ρέμα Πλατανίτη, Ρέμα Πλησίον Ηφαίστου, Ρέμα Φαναρίου. Οι ώρες εργασίας (διάρκεια μίσθωσης) της κάθε ομάδας είναι: ΟΜΑΔΑ ΩΡΕΣ ΜΙΣΘΩΣΗΣ 1η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 2η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 3η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1581,7672 4η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 5η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1300 6η ΟΜΑΔΑ 2000 Οι ώρες εργασίας του κάθε συνεργείου, υπολογίζονται ότι θα εξαντληθούν συνεχόμενα ή τμηματικά, σε χρονική διάρκεια είκοσι τεσσάρων (24) μηνών, όπως αναλυτικότερα περιγράφεται στη Τεχνική Περιγραφή και Προϋπολογισμό της παροχής υπηρεσίας, προϋπολογισμού 2.000.000,00 € συμπεριλαμβανομένου Φ.Π.Α.

title: Greece – 4-wheel-drive vehicles – ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΙΑ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ ΕΝΙΣΧΥΣΗΣ ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗΣ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ ΤΟΥ ΔΗΜΟΥ ΔΥΤΙΚΗΣ ΣΑΜΟΥ
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια εξοπλισμού για τη ενίσχυση της πολιτικής προστασίας του Δήμου Δυτικής Σάμου στη λειτουργική βάση του μηχανισμού διαχείρισης κρίσεων και αντιμετώπισης φυσικών κινδύνων και συγκεκριμένα δύο ημιφορτηγών οχημάτων 4x4, τα οποία, αντίστοιχα, θα φέρουν πυροσβεστικό και εκχιονιστικό εξοπλισμό, ενός ανατρεπόμενου φορτηγού και ενός ερπυστριοφόρου εκσκαφέα. title: Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) Production
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE IS PUBLISHED FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THE GOVERNMENT IS NOT SEEKING OR ACCEPTING UNSOLICITED PROPOSALS. This notice is a Request for Information (RFI) as defined in FAR 15.101(c). The Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems (PAE MS) is conducting market research for the Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS). ACNS helps to determine vessel position based on optical sighting of celestial objects including stars and resident space objects (RSOs) such as satellites and space debris. Ship�s position derived from ACNS shall be used to improve the resilience of the surface ship Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) system of systems suite by providing an Alternative Position Source (APS) to support Assured PNT. U.S. Navy and commercial enterprises leverage a variety of navigation solutions that allow vessels to safely navigate with and without GPS. The U.S. Navy is looking to modernize legacy systems over time. This RFI seeks information on prospective technologies that could be leveraged or developed as enablers for an ACNS solution. This RFI seeks to understand how interested parties would integrate the ACNS with navigation sensors and other ship equipment specifically Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Service (GPNTS). PAE MS invites all interested potential sources, including small business concerns, to submit written information sufficient to demonstrate the respondent�s ability to fulfill the requirements. For those interested parties that have technologies which may not achieve a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 8-9 by FY 2029, please provide information on current research and development efforts that may address some or all requirements of this RFI beyond FY 2029. Responses are requested by 27 November 2026. Questions or clarifications related to this RFI may be submitted electronically to Ms. Liz Bonilla-Sotomayor at liz.c.bonilla-sotomayor.civ@us.navy.mil and Ms. Andrea Longo at andrea.t.longo.civ@us.navy.mil. Verbal questions will not be accepted. Questions shall not contain classified information. Please ensure that the subject line of any emails containing responses or questions related to this notice includes the name of your firm and �Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) RFI Response� (without quotation marks) in the subject line. Responses are limited to a maximum of fifteen (15) pages in length, excluding the cover page, within a minimum font size of 10 points. Generic capability statements that do not address the information requested in this RFI will be deemed non-responsive without any further communication from the Government. All responsive submissions received by the due date noted in this RFI may be considered by the Government to inform the resulting Request for Proposal. All information received bearing proprietary markings will be handled in accordance with applicable statutes and regulations. Responses to this notice will not be returned and will be maintained or destroyed in accordance with the Government�s records management policy. An acknowledgement of receipt will be provided for all responses received. If you do not receive an acknowledgement within two working days, please notify the points of contact listed in this notice. All materials submitted in response to this RFI should be UNCLASSIFIED. Responses to this notice must include the following: Include a cover page containing the following information: Sources Sought number for this notice (N00024-27-IWS-6-0002) Company Name Mailing address and physical address (if different) DUNS number CAGE code Business size status (based on NAICS code 334511) Type of small business (if applicable) Facility Security Clearance (FSC) level Name, position, email address, and phone number of point(s) of contact Interested parties submitting proposed solutions shall include the following in the RFI submission: Provide System Characteristics: Average position fix accuracy of the proposed system; Operational capabilities across day, twilight, and nighttime conditions; Ephemeris data age for fix accuracy; How quality of each position fix is indicated; Ability of the system to accept data formats sourced from the United States Naval Observatory (USNO); Type of Earth Orientation Parameter (EOP) data format; Average position fix frequency rate (for Stars-Only and Stars-Satellites). Provide Component Characteristics: 1) What is the current configuration of the proposed system? 2) Sensor volume and physical dimensions; 3) Sensor weight; 4) What environmental Military Standards does your proposed system meet (i.e. MIL-STD-810H CH1 (Environmental Engineering Considerations and Laboratory Tests), MIL-STD-167-1A (Mechanical Vibrations of Shipboard Equipment), MIL-DTL-901E (High-Impact Mechanical Shock for Shipboard Machinery and Equipment), and MIL-STD-461H (Electromagnetic Interference Characteristics of Subsystems and Equipment)? title: Light Interference Filter (LIF)
description: DLA Weapons Support at Aberdeen is issuing solicitation SPRBL127RA008 as a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) on October 28, 2026, for a five (5) year, Firm-Fixed Price (FFP), Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (ID/IQ) type contract, with a proposed maximum contract value of $8,677,861.69. The proposed action is for the acquisition of Light Interference Filter (LIF), NSN: 5855-01-379-1410. The Government owns the Technical Data Package (TDP), which is the Light Interference Filter Performance Specification, for this item. The solicitation will include instructions to request these documents. Due to the sensitive nature of this item, potential sources will have to request and receive authorization prior to the release of this information. Night Vision Devices and components, and their associated technical data, are restricted from export by the International Trafficking in Arms Regulation (ITAR), Part 121, Category XII. The TDP is subject to the Internal Traffic in Arms Regulations. Any Offeror who wants to request a copy of the TDP must be registered in the Joint Certification Program, website is below: https://public.logisticsinformationservice.dla.mil/PublicHome/jcp/default.aspx Requests for a copy of the TDP after the RFP is issued must include proof of DD Form 2345 JCP Certification and proof of Facility Security Clearance (FCL) / Level of Safeguarding for Classified Information / Material of SECRET / SECRET. The documents to retrieve the TDP are attached to this solicitation. First Article Testing (FAT) will be required, which will be detailed in the solicitation. An Offeror may request a FAT waiver if certain conditions are met. A DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specification is part of this requirement and will be included in the RFP. To be eligible for award, an Offeror will be required to have access to classified data. The required Facility Security Clearance (FCL) / Level of Safeguarding for Classified Information / Material is SECRET / SECRET. The anticipated hardware ship to location will be W25G1U, New Cumberland, PA. The Government required delivery will be listed in the solicitation. Please do not wait until the last minute to submit your proposals once the solicitation is issued. To avoid potential submission of a late proposal, we recommend the transmission of your proposal file 24 hours prior to the required proposal due date and time. title: MP-130008, N02 tunnel du Seelisberg, 2. remise en état Lot 1.1 Approvisionnement en énergie de moyenne tension
description:
Le tunnel du Seelisberg fait partie de l’autoroute A2 située entre les cantons de Nidwald et d’Uri, constituant ainsi un élément important de la liaison autoroutière entre la partie nord de la Suisse et le sud du Tessin. Le portail nord se situe à Beckenried, dans le canton de Nidwald, tandis que le portail sud se trouve à Bolzbach, dans la localité de Seedorf (UR), sur la rive ouest du lac d’Uri. Il a été construit entre 1971 et 1980.

Les équipements d’exploitation et de sécurité (EES) du tunnel du Seelisberg se trouvent à différents stades de leur cycle de vie en raison des mesures d’entretien et de remplacement partiel. Il convient désormais de les ramener à l’état actuel de la technique, de façon échelonnée et en différents lots.


Le présent lot 1.1 couvre le remplacement progressif de l’approvisionnement énergétique pendant l’exploitation en cours (exploitation en parallèle), ainsi que la fourniture et l’installation d’environ :

27 transformateurs

18 convertisseurs de fréquence (aération)

10 appareillages de commutation à moyenne tension

Commande : commande d’installation, commande locale / surveillance de l’approvisionnement énergétique

Installation basse tension des galeries d’évacuation des matériaux appelées Schutterstollen (sous-station de Beckenried et nouvel accès à la centrale de ventilation de Rütenen, ainsi que le démantèlement et l’évacuation des anciens composants de l’approvisionnement énergétique.)

title: Strategisk evaluering af Aalborg Kommunes deltagelse i byudviklingsselskabet Stigsborg P/S og udviklingen af Stigsborg Havnefront
description: Aalborg Kommune ønsker en uvildig evaluering af kommunens deltagelse i byudviklingsselskabet Stigsborg P/S. Evalueringen skal belyse de økonomiske, organisatoriske, juridiske og markedsmæssige konsekvenser af den valgte udviklingsmodel samt identificere de erfaringer og læringspunkter, der kan understøtte Aalborg Kommunes planlægning og gennemførelse af de kommende etaper af Stigsborg Havnefront. Evalueringen skal have karakter af en strategisk og beslutningsunderstøttende analyse og skal kunne anvendes som grundlag for både økonomiske, organisatoriske og politiske drøftelser om den fremtidige udvikling af området.

title: Spain – Hotel accommodation services – concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana (C-2026/032)
description: El objeto del presente contrato es la concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana, de titularidad municipal, situado en el municipio de Alcalá de Guadaíra, que comprende la gestión integral del establecimiento, así como la ejecución de las actuaciones necesarias de rehabilitación, reforma, posible ampliación y adecuación del inmueble para su correcto funcionamiento y mejora de categoría, todo ello conforme a lo establecido en el correspondiente pliego de prescripciones técnicas. La presente contratación tiene como finalidad la transformación integral del establecimiento hotelero, con el objetivo de su adecuación a los estándares actuales del sector y su posicionamiento como hotel de cuatro estrellas, mediante la ejecución de las actuaciones constructivas necesarias y la implantación de un modelo de gestión profesionalizado, eficiente y orientado a la calidad. No se pretende con esta licitación una mera explotación del establecimiento en su estado actual, sino la definición y desarrollo de un proyecto global y coherente que integre la intervención sobre el inmueble con un modelo de gestión hotelera alineado con el valor patrimonial, paisajístico y turístico del entorno en el que se inserta, contribuyendo a reforzar la identidad y singularidad del destino. En este sentido, la concesión deberá orientarse a la creación de una oferta hotelera de calidad, capaz de atraer tanto a visitantes como a usuarios locales, generando actividad económica, empleo y sinergias con otros sectores vinculados al turismo, la cultura y la hostelería, y actuando como elemento dinamizador del municipio y su entorno. Asimismo, el contrato comprende tanto la ejecución de las obras definidas como obligatorias, como, en su caso, la incorporación de mejoras propuestas por los licitadores, así como la gestión integral del establecimiento, incluyendo todos los servicios necesarios para su correcto funcionamiento. El detalle y alcance de todas estas prestaciones se desarrollan en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas que rige la presente contratación.

title: Sweden – Construction work – NY100136 Heliotropen etapp 2, totalentreprenad - förhandlat förfarande
description: Objektet avser etapp 2 av MKB:s nyproduktion av flerbostadshus på fastigheten Heliotropen 6 i Malmö. Denna upphandling är en övergång från öppet förfarande till förhandlat förfarande med föregående annonsering (6 kap. 6 § LOU). Detta med anledning av att inkomna anbud har bedömts som oacceptabla, då de inte inryms inom projektets budget. Det ursprungliga upphandlingsunderlaget har kompletterats med bilagor "ÄndringsPM_NY100136" samt "Frågor och svar under anbudstid". Ansökan att delta i upphandlingen med det förhandlade förfarandet görs genom insändande av ifyllt anbudsansökansformulär med angivande av anbudspris beaktat av de ändringar som framgår av bilaga "ÄndringsPM_NY100136". Anbudssökande som uppfyller ställda krav och bedöms kunna komma i fråga för tilldelning av kontrakt med utgångspunkt från anbudssökandes offererade anbud i förhållande till MKB:s fastställda målbudget kommer att kallas till förhandling för att därefter få möjlighet att inkomma med ett slutligt anbud. Slutliga anbud kommer att utvärderas i enlighet med i förfrågningsunderlaget angiven utvärderingsmodell.
